title: Bug 648782: omit the buyer PartyTaxScheme when the company has no VAT registration
summary: Purchase order PEPPOL export now omits the PartyTaxScheme block when the company has no VAT registration number, preventing invalid XML validation failures.
key_points: PartyTaxScheme block is skipped entirely when VAT Registration No. is empty
Prevents schema validation errors caused by mandatory CompanyID element inside an otherwise optional block
Aligns behavior with remittance advice and sales XMLports
No VAT number fallback to GLN to avoid reporting incorrect tax data
Low risk change only affecting companies without VAT registration
quote: The block is optional but CompanyID inside it is mandatory, so the Order fails schematron validation.
